# Contributing

First off, thanks for taking the time to make the world a little happier and gayer! 🏳️‍🌈

LezWatch.TV (AKA LWTV) welcomes all contributions from all walks of life.

If you want to recommend shows or characters to add, or you found a mistake in the data, please go to the [LWTV Contact Page](https://lezwatchtv.com/about/contact/) and let us know what we're missing. You can even ask for API and code changes there!

## Code of Conduct

This project and everyone participating in it is governed by the [LWTV Code of Conduct](blob/production/docs/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). By participating, you are expected to uphold this code. Please report unacceptable behavior to `<webmaster@lezwatchtv.com>`.

## I Have a Question

Make sure you've read the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://lezwatchtv.com/about/faq/) first! We try to get ahead of any queries.

If you then still have a question there are a few options:

1. Open an [Issue](/issues/new)
2. Come to [Slack](https://lezwatchtv.com/about/slack/)

In both cases, remember:

- Provide as much context as you can about what you're running into.
- Provide software versions, depending on what seems relevant (e.g. "Mac OS, Chrome")

We will then take care of the issue as soon as possible.

## I Want To Contribute

**When contributing to this project, you must agree that you have authored 100% of the content, that you have the necessary rights to the content and that the content you contribute may be provided under the project license.**

### Website Content Corrections

The best way to do that is to go to the [LWTV Contact Page](https://lezwatchtv.com/about/contact/).

While you _can_ use an issue for that, the contact page sends message to all editors so anyone can fix the content faster.

### Bug Reports

> If you are attempting to report a security issue, please do not open an issue. Instead, we ask you use the feature ["Report a Vulnerability"](https://github.com/LezWatch/lwtv-underscores/security/advisories/new).

A good bug report shouldn't leave others needing to chase you up for more information. The best reports explain precisely what you were doing when something unexpected (and not correct) happened. We know it's asking a lot for you to be explicit when you're probably frustrated at something being broken, but it will help us fix it a lot faster when you're specific.

**Before submitting a report about the website:**

1. Make sure you've emptied your cache and/or tried on a separate browser
2. Provide information about your environment:
  - What OS are you using?
  - What Browser are you using?
3. Collect information about the bug:
  - What were you trying to do?
  - What did you expect to happen?
  - What _actually_ happened?

**Before submitting a report about the repository:**

1. Make sure that you are using the `production` branch
2. Determine if your bug is really a bug and not an error on your side e.g. using incompatible environment components/versions.
3. Check if there is not already a bug report existing for your bug or error in the [bug tracker](issues?q=label%3Abug).
4. Collect information about the bug:
  - Stack trace (Traceback)
  - OS, Platform and Version (Windows, Linux, macOS, x86, ARM)
  - Version of the interpreter, compiler, SDK, runtime environment, package manager, depending on what seems relevant.
  - Possibly your input and the output
5. Can you reliably reproduce the issue? And can you also reproduce it with older versions?

### Suggesting Enhancements

We are constantly working on and improving our features. Some of them are for back-end work (like our integration with WikiData to extract information on Actors), but others connect us with TVMaze for the calendar.

If you have an idea for an enhancement, a new feature, or have some code you want us to use, we would love to see it!

## Styleguides

We use PHPCS and WPCS to enforce our coding standards.

While we _recommend_ good commit messages, we know that sometimes "Arg! Fixed it!" happens.

See also: https://docs.lezwatchtv.com/admin/development/

## Join The Team

Want to devote your free time to hunting down information about TV shows, characters, and actors in queer media? Want to write code to make all this better? Just want to talk about queer TV?

Come to [Slack](https://lezwatchtv.com/about/slack/)! We'd love to have you.
